trust_pages.title: About and Editorial Standards
trust_pages.purpose: Explain who the site is for, what the editorial promise is, and how AI-assisted content is reviewed before publication.

trust_pages.title: Source and Update Policy
trust_pages.purpose: Define acceptable source types, claim support expectations, source-review cadence, and update triggers.

trust_pages.title: Contact and Corrections
trust_pages.purpose: Give readers a way to report errors, request clarifications, or raise source concerns.

trust_pages.title: Privacy and Disclosures
trust_pages.purpose: State data handling, affiliate/sponsorship disclosures if any, analytics posture, and privacy contact path.

production_required_change.robots_txt: Allow intended public URLs only after publish-batch approval; keep review/admin/artifact paths blocked.
production_required_change.html_meta: Remove noindex only from explicitly approved production pages; keep non-approved staging/review artifacts noindex.
production_required_change.sitemap: Generate sitemap only for production-approved URLs and exclude review artifacts.

pre_publish: Confirm brand/domain and final URL structure.
Prepare Search Console property after domain decision.
Decide analytics tool and privacy disclosure wording.
Keep staging preview unindexed and exclude it from production metrics.
post_publish_metrics: Engagement proxy by page type if analytics credentials exist
